3:16.text: Those who say: "Our Lord! We have indeed believed, so forgive us our sins and save us from the punishment of the Fire."

3:17.text: those who are patient, those who are true
, and obedient with sincere devotion in worship to Allâh. Those who spend
[give the Zakât and alms in the Way of Allâh]
and those who pray and beg Allâh’s Pardon in the last hours of the night.

3:18.text: Allâh bears witness that Lâ ilâha illa Huwa
(none has the right to be worshipped but He)
, and the angels, and those having knowledge
maintains His creation in Justice. Lâ ilâha illa Huwa
(none has the right to be worshipped but He)

3:19.text: Truly, the religion with Allâh is Islâm. Those who were given the Scripture
did not differ except, out of mutual jealousy, after knowledge had come to them. And whoever disbelieves in the Ayât
of Allâh, then surely, Allâh is Swift in calling to account.

3:20.text: So if they dispute with you
say: "I have submitted myself to Allâh
those who follow me." And say to those who were given the Scripture
and to those who are illiterates
?" If they do, they are rightly guided; but if they turn away, your duty is only to convey the Message; and Allâh is All-Seer of

3:21.text: Verily! Those who disbelieve in the Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
of Allâh and kill the Prophets without right, and kill those men who order just dealings, ... then announce to them a painful torment.

3:22.text: They are those whose works will be lost in this world and in the Hereafter, and they will have no helpers.
